name: The Ventriloquist
description: svchost.exe with a valid hash and Microsoft signature running from C:\Users\Public\Downloads, with parent cmd.exe and a persistent connection to an IP in an unusual country. The process is legitimate, the configuration isn't.
devil_advocate: svchost.exe is a legitimate binary, but its path, parent process, and C2 connection are anomalous. The attacker uses the binary as a puppet.

custodyEvents.detail: EDR alert on svchost.exe running from an unusual path.
custodyEvents.detail_es: Alerta de EDR: svchost.exe ejecutándose desde una ruta inusual.

custodyEvents.detail: Memory snapshot and network capture acquired.
custodyEvents.detail_es: Instantánea de memoria y captura de red adquiridas.

custodyEvents.detail: Deterministic engine ran over the acquired artifacts.
custodyEvents.detail_es: El motor determinista corrió sobre los artefactos adquiridos.

artifacts.description: svchost.exe running from Downloads, not from System32. Parent process: cmd.exe. Valid hash, valid Microsoft signature.
artifacts.description_es: svchost.exe ejecutándose desde Downloads, no desde System32. Parent process: cmd.exe. Hash válido, firma Microsoft válida.

artifacts.description: Persistent HTTPS connection every 60 seconds to an IP in a country where the company has no operations — the network behavior contradicts what a real svchost.exe should ever be doing.
artifacts.description_es: Conexión HTTPS persistente cada 60 segundos a IP en país sin operaciones de la empresa.

peirce_chain.firstness: Legitimate process in an unusual path with a suspicious parent.
peirce_chain.secondness: Persistent C2 connection to a geographically anomalous IP.
peirce_chain.thirdness: The attacker uses a trusted binary as a puppet. The valid signature doesn't clean the behavior.

demo_quote: A valid digital signature doesn't make an execution legitimate. The context — path, parent, network — gives away the ventriloquist.
description_es: svchost.exe con hash válido y firma Microsoft ejecutándose desde C:\Users\Public\Downloads, con parent cmd.exe y conexión persistente a IP en país inusual. El proceso es legítimo, la configuración no.
devil_advocate_es: svchost.exe es un binario legítimo, pero su ruta, parent process y conexión C2 son anómalos. El atacante usa el binario como marioneta.
demo_quote_es: Una firma digital válida no hace legítima una ejecución. El contexto —ruta, parent, red— delata al ventrílocuo.

peirce_chain_es.firstness: Proceso legítimo en ruta inusual con parent sospechoso.
peirce_chain_es.secondness: Conexión C2 persistente a IP geográficamente anómala.
peirce_chain_es.thirdness: El atacante usa un binario confiable como marioneta. La firma válida no limpia el comportamiento.
